radiusSource: Radius 3.429 (3.353 to 3.507) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 2,385,755 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 3.356 (3.313 to 3.399) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 11577 +/- 36.7 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 65287458566524928: teff_gspphot 11576.752 K (16th-84th percentiles 11538.454-11611.823), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 65287458566524928: teff_gspphot 11576.752 K (16th-84th percentiles 11538.454-11611.823), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
